channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-gemini-cli
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: Sequenzy — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Hosted MCP server for Sequenzy, an email marketing platform for SaaS and ecommerce: manage subscribers, lists, tags and segments, build campaigns, sequences and templates, send transactional email, run A/B tests and read delivery stats from Gemini CLI. About 420 tools, each annotated read-only or destructive. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in (an API key also works); free plan with 2,500 emails/month. MIT. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/Sequenzy/mcp, then /mcp auth sequenzy. Local stdio alternative: npx -y @sequenzy/mcp with SEQUENZY_API_KEY.

item.title: Hermoso — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Gemini CLI extension for marketing: research competitors' ads in the Meta, Google and LinkedIn ad libraries, generate image, video and UGC avatar ads, post and schedule to your own social channels, and manage Meta Ads, Google Ads and TikTok Ads campaigns, through skills that drive the hermoso CLI. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/hermoso-ai/hermoso.

item.title: Chisle — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Gemini CLI extension whose GEMINI.md makes answers shorter without dropping decisive facts: no filler or hedging, the smallest code that works (reuse, stdlib and installed dependencies before new code), and reading less (grep before opening files, sliced reads). Benchmarks with raw transcripts are in the repo. npx chisle mcp wrap also trims oversized MCP tool output in Gemini CLI. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/JayPokale/Chisle. MIT.

item.title: Log10x — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Gemini CLI extension that installs the log10x MCP server (MIT, local stdio). It ranks log patterns by volume and cost and plans an action for the excess over each cap: compact on Splunk and self-managed Elasticsearch, tier down or offload to S3 on other platforms. No log data reaches log10x. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/log-10x/log10x-plugin.

item.title: pando — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Terminal workspace that runs Gemini CLI side by side with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and shells, each session in its own git worktree, under a daemon that keeps them running when the TUI closes. Marks a Gemini session running or waiting for approval, reviews and commits its diff in the TUI, and has a CLI that blocks on session status.

item.title: Candor Finance — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Personal finance for Gemini CLI from your own US bank, card, loan, and investment accounts: spending, cash flow, a budget, and goals with a target, a date, and a monthly amount, saved across sessions, plus a weekly review that tells Gemini what is worth talking through. Bank access is read-only and no tool moves money. Hosted MCP server with OAuth sign-in plus 10 agent skills; requires a Candor account. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/candorsystems/candor-finance, then /mcp auth candor.

item.title: repofit — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: MCP server and CLI that reads what local coding agents already keep (Gemini CLI chats and GEMINI.md, plus Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and others) and recommends GitHub projects for the tasks you repeat, each pick citing the session it came from. Also lists installed MCP servers and skills that no session ever called. Runs locally and uses the agent's own model, so no API key. MIT. Add with gemini mcp add repofit uvx repofit mcp.

item.title: Skim — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Browser extension that renders the Markdown plans and docs Gemini CLI writes, re-rendering live as the file changes. KaTeX, Mermaid, folder view.

item.title: Keenable — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Web search and page fetch as clean Markdown from Keenable, a search engine with its own crawler and index built for AI agents. Gemini CLI extension that adds Keenable's hosted MCP server (search_web_pages, fetch_page_content) and a web-lookup skill; keyless, no signup or API key (rate limited per IP). MIT. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/keenableai/keenable-antigravity.

item.title: AlphaOSINT LinkedIn Company — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Remote MCP server for Gemini CLI that returns a company's LinkedIn page details (size, industry, locations, specialties) through https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=johnvc/linkedin-company-api.

item.title: AgentVera — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs Gemini CLI side by side with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and 13 more coding agents per project, each in a real terminal using your own Gemini CLI install and login. A team kanban board hands cards to agents, and an MCP manager is built in. Closed source; free plan, Pro $9.99/month.

item.title: mach-gtm-mcp — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Open-source B2B outbound sales MCP server: build ICPs, research prospects with verified buying signals, score leads (0-100), draft cold emails and LinkedIn messages (1-3-1 framework), and generate multi-touch sequences. Human approval required before any message is sent. Works with Gemini CLI and any MCP client. Install: npx mach-gtm-mcp.

item.title: Preloop — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Open-source AI agent control plane and software factory: every tool and model call allowed, denied or held for a human, budgeted and recorded, and agents run from tickets, webhooks and CI in hosted containers or on your own runners, landing work as pull requests. Works with Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode and Copilot CLI. Apache-2.0.

item.title: Ponder — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Gemini CLI extension and Agent Skill for multi-pass deliberation and code review: grades every file or document across 6 dimensions, runs four adversarial perspectives (skeptic, builder, dreamer, empath), and blocks early stopping until coverage reaches 1.00 and churn converges below 0.02 across two consecutive passes. Zero runtime dependencies, MIT. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/Quinnod345/ponder or npx skills add Quinnod345/ponder -y -a gemini-cli.

item.title: Joxo — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Shared project for a team's coding agents. Start Gemini CLI with joxo gemini and it works from the same task board, decisions and handoffs as teammates' Claude Code, Codex or Cursor agents, and can ask a teammate's agent for help. Desktop app, iPhone app and a remote MCP server.

item.title: EndoStack — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Security-first workflows for coding agents: 62 skills that threat-model changes, security-review diffs and verify results by running them. Works in Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 11 other agents. MIT.

item.title: vidbyte-memory — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Gemini CLI extension and GitHub template for correction-driven memory: corrections become facts Gemini loads, pytest tests where a check can be written, and git commits, and the installer adds an AfterAgent hook that sends Gemini back to work (up to 5 times in a row) while tests fail.

item.title: mock-interview — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Agent Skill that runs in Gemini CLI and other agents (npx skills add georgesmomo/mock-interview). Runs a realistic mock job interview for any role, with research on the job and real follow-up questions, then gives an honest score out of 10 and a written report.

item.title: Railse — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Self-hosted approval inbox for Gemini CLI, Claude Code and Codex: hooks route every tool call through risk-based rules; for Gemini CLI that means deny rules plus phone notifications for questions and completion, with approvals from the phone for Claude Code and Codex.

item.title: JobsPipe — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Hosted MCP server and Gemini CLI extension for live job postings from 30+ ATS feeds and job boards in one normalized schema: search by role, place, date, salary, seniority, skills and visa stance, read a posting in full, and save searches as alerts. OAuth sign-in or API key, free plan. gemini extensions install https://github.com/jobspipe/mcp.

item.title: OpenCode Mobile — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Independent, unofficial, open-source (MIT) Android app that runs Gemini CLI, with Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code and other agents, on the phone itself in an Ubuntu environment it installs inside the app, or connects to an agent on your computer. Approve tool requests from a notification or widget, review diffs, preview the dev server. Made by its owner with substantial AI assistance.

item.title: Mobbin — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Gemini CLI extension that gives Gemini 600,000+ real app screens, flows and website sections from Mobbin as UI references, plus skills to search them and redesign a screen from patterns real apps ship, in your own design system. Remote MCP https://api.mobbin.com/mcp with OAuth sign-in (Pro, Team or Enterprise plan). Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/mobbin/skills, then /mcp auth mobbin.

item.title: Kin — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Gemini CLI extension for Kin: use your accounts from Gemini CLI, even two of one service, each with its own rule per action (Allow, Ask me or Block), through Kin's hosted MCP server. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/kinlab-ai/kin-plugin.

item.title: recall — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: MCP server that reads and writes Claude Code's per-project auto memory (Markdown files with [[wiki-links]]), so Gemini CLI, Codex and Cursor share the same memories. memory_recall follows links within a token budget; optional read-only mode. Zero dependencies, local only. MIT. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/fainir/recall (serves the memory of the folder you start Gemini in) or run npx -y @fainir/recall.

item.title: frugal — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Gemini CLI extension and Agent Skill: before anything is bought, subscribed to or upgraded, Gemini checks free tiers, the right plan and billing period, startup, student, open-source and nonprofit programs, verified promo codes and cheaper alternatives, then reports the best options with sources. Never pays by itself. MIT. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/fainir/frugal.

item.title: Ironheights — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Offline security scanner that protects any AI bot's skills: scans any skill folder with a SKILL.md (including Gemini CLI skills in ~/.gemini/skills/) for prompt injection, credential theft, and other risky patterns before you install it, with findings tagged by OWASP LLM Top 10 and OpenCRE ID. Reads files as data, never runs them, no telemetry. Run npx ironheights scan ./path/to/skill. Apache-2.0.

item.title: GetYouTubeTranscript — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: YouTube transcripts and data for Gemini CLI: fetch a video's transcript (pick the language, optional timestamps), search YouTube, browse a channel's videos, playlists and posts, search inside a channel, list a playlist, find related videos, and read a channel banner or estimated dislikes. 13 tools. Hosted Streamable HTTP; tool calls need an API key from the dashboard (1 credit per call, 100 credits on sign-up, paid plans from $5/month). MIT. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http --header "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" getyoutubetranscript https://getyoutubetranscript.com/api/mcp.

item.title: DESIGN:OS — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Free design CLI and skill pack for Gemini CLI, Claude Code and Codex. Describe a UI in plain words and get web, Figma and SwiftUI output checked by deterministic taste gates; installs with npx @easestart/design-os init. Source-available (PolyForm Shield).

item.title: self-host — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Lets your agent install self-hosted apps on your own hardware and set them up (admin accounts, API keys, apps connected to each other), asking before each step.

item.title: codecall — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Agent Skill that runs in Gemini CLI and other agents (npx skills add GAURAV-1313/codecall). Quizzes you on the code your agent just wrote, traces one request flow file by file, or plants one bug for a debugging-interview drill and restores it with Git. No API key.

item.title: Tera Studio — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Hosted MCP server for singers over remote Streamable HTTP, no key or sign-in: find_song_key looks up a well-known song's key, tempo and typical vocal range by title, and the other tools return links to free browser tools that find a song file's key and BPM or move it up to 6 semitones. Add with gemini mcp add --transport http tera-studio https://terastudio.co/mcp.

item.title: Tavero — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: MCP server and CLI that finds UI inconsistencies (spacing, colors, typography, component drift) in running React apps and gives coding agents fixes with file/line references. Works with Gemini CLI as an MCP server. Run: npx -y tavero mcp. Free, MIT.

item.title: Scarwise — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Gemini CLI hooks (BeforeTool/AfterTool) that learn from failed tool calls by themselves and stop a known mistake before it runs; what one agent learns protects your other agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and more).

item.title: Recommerce — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for second-hand purchases: compare listings, assemble kits, inspect items, plan collection, weigh keep vs. repair vs. replace, and recheck before committing. Read-only, no API key, never contacts sellers or buys. MIT. Install with npx skills add budna-marketplace/recommerce -y -a gemini-cli.

item.title: MCP Probe Kit — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Diagnostics and self-test toolkit for MCP servers: enumerates every tool, resource and prompt, exercises them, and reports health, latency and schema drift between runs. Read-only against the target server, so you can point it at any server you connect Gemini CLI to and see what it actually exposes. MIT, npx -y mcp-probe-kit, official MCP Registry io.github.mybolide/mcp-probe-kit.

item.title: MAO — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Native desktop canvas for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs Gemini CLI (0.41 or later) as a built-in agent alongside Claude Code, Codex, Grok, OpenCode, Antigravity and shell agents, each as a real terminal node on its own login. Wired agents hand each other tasks through the mao CLI, an Orchestrator agent can recruit and direct the others, and each layer is a git worktree whose diff you review and land from the canvas. Closed source; US$20 one-time, 7-day free trial.

item.title: Coding Tools MCP — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Desktop MCP workspace for coding agents: file edits, command execution, Git status and resumable history sessions behind one local stdio interface, so Gemini CLI gets project scaffolding and code search without four separate servers. Apache-2.0, official MCP Registry io.github.mybolide/coding-tools-mcp.

item.title: Carbon Forge — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Hosted MCP server for source control and a shared record: Gemini CLI can read and write code, files and prose in one record on the server, open a lane instead of cloning, and land a change as one all-or-nothing changeset. Remote Streamable HTTP at https://carbonforge.dev/api/mcp; public workspaces read without a token, writing needs a bearer token.

item.title: Budna MCP — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Read-only MCP server for Budna, a Swedish second-hand marketplace: search and inspect public listings, categories, filters, seller profiles, and bid and rating summaries from Gemini CLI. 11 tools, interactive listing cards in MCP Apps clients. Local stdio, no API key, no account. MIT. Run with npx --yes @budna-marketplace/mcp.

item.title: BankBridge — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Hosted MCP server that lets Gemini CLI answer questions about your own US bank, credit card and investment accounts: spending by category or merchant, recurring charges, monthly cashflow, holdings. 12 read-only tools, data fetched live on each call; it can't move money. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in. Paid, $5/mo per connected bank. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/bankbridge-money/bankbridge-plugin, then /mcp auth bankbridge.

item.title: Aixle Flow — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Self-hosted Kanban board that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI and other coding agents, each in its own container. Moving a card starts a durable workflow with parallel steps, approval gates and per-run token and cost tracking.

item.title: Agent Notifications — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Cross-platform desktop notifications and optional webhooks for Gemini CLI turn completion and tool permission requests. Also supports Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, and Qoder.

item.title: UI Verify — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Visual testing for coding agents: your agent sees every UI change it makes, so visual bugs never reach production. Gemini CLI extension with 9 Agent Skills (set up visual regression tests for Storybook, Playwright and Vitest, keep captures deterministic, triage a build's changes) and the hosted UI Verify MCP server (15 tools) that shows the agent each change as a before and after against the baseline and lets it accept the intended ones. OAuth login in the browser, no API key in config. Skills are MIT; the service is hosted, free for 10,000 snapshots a month and 50,000 for open-source projects. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/uiverify/uiverify, then run /mcp auth uiverify.

item.title: NeverApply — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Hosted job-search MCP server for Gemini CLI: search and match jobs, tailor resumes, answer screening questions, prepare for interviews, and apply to jobs with your approval. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, no API key; free plan available. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http neverapply https://neverapply.co/mcp.

item.title: Model Salt — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: MCP server that gives the model randomness from outside it, so one prompt gives different pictures, stories, names and designs that still do what you asked. One tool, model_salt; add it with npx -y model-salt setup gemini. MIT.

item.title: Landed MCP — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Hosted MCP server for job search in Gemini CLI: rank AI and tech jobs against a role brief, read application forms, and fetch interview prep. No key needed.

item.title: MarketMirror — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Gemini CLI extension and MCP server that tests ads, prices, emails and sales pitches on simulated buyers and writes a go / iterate / no-go report. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/DarkWorldCoder/market-mirror.

item.title: BrewPage — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: MCP server for brewpage.app, free hosting with no account: Gemini CLI publishes HTML, Markdown, files, multi-file static sites, JSON and key-value data and gets a shareable link back (20 tools). Connect to the remote endpoint https://brewpage.app/mcp (no auth) or install the extension with gemini extensions install https://github.com/kochetkov-ma/brewpage-openapi. Content expires after 15 days by default (up to 30).

item.title: SitePatent — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Search SitePatent, a screened discovery platform for newly launched startups, tools and online products, from Gemini CLI: keyword search with category and pricing filters, full listing profiles, alternatives to a named product, categories and trending listings. 7 read-only tools. Remote Streamable HTTP, no API key, no account: gemini mcp add --transport http sitepatent https://sitepatent.com/api/mcp.

item.title: SwarmPane — via awesome-gemini-cli
item.description: Desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux that runs Gemini CLI (with a Gemini API key) side by side with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Agent, Copilot, Devin and more, up to 16 at once in real terminals, with a git worktree per agent, undo for every agent step and account switching when a usage limit hits. Paid, with a 7-day trial for $1.
